notes.title: Our rhythm x boxing VR game BEAT THE BEATS is in Steam Rhythm Fest!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We’re really pumped to let you know that we are participating in Steam Rhythm Fest with our playable demo 🥊

The demo includes the tutorial and eight levels to play through. The final level can only be unlocked by getting ‘A’ grade on all previous levels. Think you’re to the challenge? 

[previewyoutube=dw3X_isMgDY;full][/previewyoutube]

The playtime is around 30 minutes on the first playthrough. If you perfect each level, you can make it in 15.

For content creators and streamers, the team has worked on making headset recording much smoother for better-quality streams and videos. The game also offers two extra camera modes to get the best output for the people watching: A tweakable fixed camera to make it easier to add recorded footage and a First Person one with smoothing options to avoid the Shaki-VR style. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2751550

We’d love for you to check out the demo and let us know any feedback you have! You can leave it in the Steam Forums, and we’ll monitor this throughout the week. 

Please be sure to add it to your wishlist, and be sure to follow us for more updates. We are planning to release the game later this year on SteamVR.

Thank you so much!
Lucas and Josef
(Parallel Circles)

notes.title: Let's play Beat the Beats VR
notes.notes:
The Steam Next Fest has begun! So many great game demos.

Join us on Saturday at 7AM PT / 3PM BST / 4PM CET to see us play our rhythm boxing game Beat the Beats VR. One of the devs will be playing and we will also be answering questions in the chat of course.

Looking forward to see you there!
Keep beating the beats! 🥊

notes.title: Introducing Boxing x Rhythm game BEAT THE BEATS!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We are Parallel Games, a massively tiny studio based in the UK and Spain. We are very excited to show you our brand new project, [b]Beat the Beats VR[/b]!

[previewyoutube=dw3X_isMgDY;full][/previewyoutube]

Beat the Beats is an electric [b]mix of rhythm and boxing game[/b]. Use actual boxing-style punches to pound your way through musical arcade levels in hypnotic VR, working up a sweat as you climb the leaderboards. 

If that sounds like something you’d enjoy, please be sure to add it to your wishlist, and be sure to follow us for more updates. We are planning to release the game later this year on SteamVR.

Thank you so much!
Lucas and Josef
(Parallel Circles)
